# Gelabber v0.13.1

A hotfix for the release pipeline: the desktop release publishes the
pacman repository reliably again. The apps and the server are the same as
in v0.13.0. No database migration and no `.env` change.

## Changes

**CI**

- The pacman repository's GitHub Pages site is uploaded a job ahead of its
  deployment. In the same job, GitHub's deploy step often did not find the
  site it had just been given, and the v0.13.0 repository went out only on
  the third attempt. #746 (GEL-73)

## Upgrade notes

- No migrations, no `.env` change. The image pins
  `GELABBER_{API,WEB,MEDIA}_IMAGE` move together to `v0.13.1`; the images
  hold the same code as `v0.13.0`. **Rollback:** the v0.13.0 image set.
- **Desktop:** Windows offers the update itself; Arch: `pacman -Syu`.

All changes: [v0.13.0...v0.13.1](https://github.com/Till-und-Scholler-AI-slop/Gelabber/compare/v0.13.0...v0.13.1)
